observations: Photo 0 shows a small blue toy-style electronic keyboard/piano with colored keys and cartoon graphics; no visible brand/model label.
Photo 1 shows the back of the same device with a sticker/label area, but the text is not readable enough to identify brand/model; no visible power adapter/battery compartment details.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a blue electronic toy keyboard/piano.

claims.claim: with all blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: Photos do not show the song list, screen/menu, or a demo playing audio.
No photo/video of the teaching mode, buttons, or on-screen prompts.

risks.risk: Not the same item as a real 'portable grand' keyboard (photos look like a small toy keyboard, not a Yamaha DGX-class instrument). This affects value heavily.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the front panel showing the full control layout and any brand/model text, plus a short video of it playing (showing the screen/buttons).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic toy electronic keyboard (worst case: basic/no-name unit).

risks.risk: Unknown power method and condition (battery-only vs adapter; may not power on).
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing it powering on and playing a note, and a photo of the battery compartment/adapter port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working until tested.

risks.risk: Song/teaching features may not work or may be limited (preloaded content claim).
risks.proof: Ask for a video scrolling/selecting 'Do re mi' (or equivalent) and playing it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as basic functions only (worst case: no verified teaching mode).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (adapter, stand, microphone, sustain pedal, manual).
risks.proof: Ask for a full accessories photo laid out (adapter/charger, cables, any pedals/stand).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of any brand/model text on the back label (closer, in focus) and the front control panel.
Send a short video: power on → press keys → show sound output; include a shot of the power source (battery compartment or adapter port).
Send a video demonstrating the 'Do re mi' / teaching mode selection and playback.
List and show all included accessories (charger/adapter, stand, pedals, manuals).
response.reason: The photos show a small toy-style blue electronic keyboard, but the seller’s claims about preloaded songs/teaching mode and the comparables provided (e.g., Yamaha DGX 520) may not match. Without readable brand/model and a working demo, a safe worst-case price cannot be determined.
